bibl.title: Greek and Coptic Paideia in Late Antique Egypt: Comparing the Incomparable?
bibl.seg: Gianfranco Agosti, Greek and Coptic Paideia in Late Antique Egypt: Comparing the Incomparable?
bibl.note: Deals with the relations between Greek highbrow literary production (especially poetry) and Coptic literature, considered as two sides of the same coin: the comparison of apparently distant texts, like epic poems in Greek and hagiographies in Coptic, can be helpful to better understand the attitude to classical paideia in Late Antique society, and to dismiss the old interpretive model of ‘the high vs the low’, too often declined as ‘Greek vs Coptic’.
